Automation

From published paper to story with audio

Run the simulation to watch one paper move through the pipeline. The only manual step is the editor's approval.

Step 1

Find

A daily check asks PubMed for new papers with our affiliation.

GitHub Actions
Step 2

Draft

The abstract is turned into a short plain-language story and tagged with a topic.

AI summary
Step 3

Review

An editor reads the draft, corrects it, adds a photo, and approves.

Person · WordPress
Step 4

Record

The approved text is converted to an MP3 and attached to the story.

Text-to-speech
Step 5

Publish

The story appears in the banner and on its own page with the player.
